stitch_shortlist.author: @sadovskaya_doctor
stitch_shortlist.claim: Not every weird-looking mole is cancer

pitch.the_claim: Atypical (dysplastic) moles are often completely harmless — don't panic over every weird one.
pitch.why_it_stitches: 1.2M in 4.5d, squarely in her lane; reassuring but half-right — patients still need to know WHICH atypical moles to watch.
pitch.your_fit: She teaches ABCDEs, 'as long as your moles all look similar that's reassuring,' and the ugly-duckling sign — a clean yes-and.
angles: empathy-first: yes, most atypical moles are harmless — here's the reassuring part
'yes, and': the one mole that looks different from the rest is the ugly duckling — that's the one to check
switch-don't-quit: skip panic-Googling, book a yearly skin check

pitch.why_it_stitches: 839K in 4.7d and pacing; surprising and mildly dangerous (a missed cancer).
pitch.your_fit: Her BCC guide (493K) + 'a pimple that won't heal in 6–8 weeks can be skin cancer' — same don't-ignore-it message.
angles: 'you want me to WHAT?': people tie floss around these — stop
empathy-first: most are benign, here's how a derm tells them apart
the 3 that mimic skin tags: wart, neurofibroma, BCC
